states.name: load coffee capsule
states.definition: Gathering mug, capsule, and water, opening the machine compartment, inserting the capsule, and filling the water tank.

states.name: brew coffee
states.definition: Pressing the button on the coffee machine to brew the coffee into the mug.

states.name: prepare milk
states.definition: Retrieving the milk bottle and frother, pouring milk into the frother, and activating the frother.

states.name: add frothed milk
states.definition: Pouring the frothed milk from the frother into the brewed coffee mug.

states.name: stir and clean
states.definition: Stirring the coffee with a wooden stirrer, discarding it, rinsing the milk frother, and washing up.
